headline: Richie's call was yesterday with no outcome on it. That is five calls with a past date and not one result recorded.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Log the five open call outcomes. Richie yesterday, luca and Evan on Aug 20, Robert on Aug 19 and Joshua Haber back on Aug 10. All five have a call date in the past and nothing after it. Two working days remain and every euro August can still book sits in those rows. Friday's EOD is missing as well, so the first proper two account week has a hole in it.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Cash. EUR 5,000 of 30,000 with Monday the last day. Nothing sent this week can reply, book and close in time, so the month lands wherever those five calls landed.
